uncovered_constraints_packaged: R03 validates a same-run cumulative runtime ledger containing exactly R01,R02 plus both handoff bytes and cross-checks the R02-recorded R01 hash before any runtime work.

The regenerated R02 business handoff must have all exact Workflow 02 headings, current target/profile/selection hashes, both real Qwen layer families, shallow/deep FX evidence, exact process inventory, alias-safe wrappers, equivalence, nesting, cleanup and a clean target.

The current R02 sidecar defines the ordered exact HIPTX adapter-name multiset and multiplicities; broad prefix matching and context markers such as qwen_dcu.generate_total cannot enter the measured set.

FX setitem and dynamic-view Proxy semantics, signature-aware input shape validation, declared layer occurrence counts and failed-attempt isolation are predecessor acceptance gates rather than work R03 may recreate or weaken.
Profiler preflight sources the pinned target environment, prepends the matching DCC library, distinguishes missing flags from formats and matches pftrace without case sensitivity.
A bare hipprof libLLVM-17git.so failure proves only that the environment was not loaded; repair and rerun no-measurement preflight without capturing the model.

Every accepted R03 capture preserves eight ordered 16-32K requests, concurrency eight, infinite request rate, 1024 outputs, two excluded warmups, deterministic sampling, ignored EOS, physical DCUs 0 and 1 and DP ranks 0 and 1 under TP1/PP1/DP2 mp.
The raw inventory requires one DB and one PFTrace, explicitly allows and hashes fixed hipkernel/hiptrace auxiliaries, rejects unknown files and never assumes the directory has only two files.
After a successful request, inventory, analyzer, classifier, correlation or report defects use unchanged raw bytes after both devices are released and cannot trigger recapture.

Strict attribution is exact HIPTX CPU range to proven HIP kernel-launch API whose start lies inside the range to a native device row with the same runtime correlation ID; time overlap, kernel name alone and layer projection are insufficient.

Nested ownership resolves to one deepest declared measured owner, fragments aggregate by aggregation_key, non-ancestor overlaps block strict attribution and one native kernel instance cannot have multiple exclusive owners.
GPU order and no-kernel fallback use first launch-owned device start, then first HIP runtime call start, then HIPTX start, exposed through gpu_order_basis.

Direct Markdown tables split matched_kernel_family into individual rows, keep family costs exclusive, label process envelope values as context and derive all timing/order tables from the same native database.

Reference exact/nearest matching, source buckets, family-aware/component-total splitting, semantic-cost/node-count weighting and projection conservation remain available only below a separate exploratory evidence_kind=projected tree.
Historical single-card timings, traces, mappings, handoffs and reports are forbidden; workload_profile contributes only taxonomy, vocabulary, schemas and reconstruction method.
Formal runtime validation has Python standard-library implementations; missing jq, rg or sqlite3 CLI is not failure and never authorizes a model rerun.
Failed R03 attempts are immutable and isolated; business outputs remain below runtime_artifact_root and the single scheduler handoff is written only to runtime_handoff_output after every gate passes.
